verdict.rationale: The Minnesota Secretary of State is a government registry of record: its core product is legally authoritative business and UCC filing and search (docs-1, docs-2, docs-4, docs-5), which cannot be run outside the state. Self-hosting is therefore a category error for this kind of product. The bulk Data and Image Subscriptions (docs-7) provide data access, not a self-hostable copy of the product, so they do not make this axis apply.
